claims.assertion: Anéeka says some Earth incarnates are nonhuman operatives who leave by ship after completing missions.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as an explanation for some disappearances.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says not everyone who wants to leave Earth can be physically extracted, citing logistics and moral constraints.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says Earth’s experience can exceed what souls expected.
